# Docs scope instructions

These instructions give ScopeBot context that is specific to this repository. They do not change
the comment templates, the outcomes, or the safe-output limits.

## Version scope

This repository documents Elastic Stack 9.x and Serverless. Do not ask which 8.x version shipped a
feature, and do not recommend 8.x work, unless the issue itself asks for an 8.x backport.
